items.title: 61529_Maxine Sullivan oral history interview
items.q: the first record date that I had used John Kirby's men, he had along with Babe, Pete Brown, alto Man, and Frankie Newton.

ctx.x:
There's story that John
Kirby went uptown somewhere. Excuse me, went
downtown and got himself a contract to play on
52nd Street for a band he didn't have at the time.
So he went uptown and got the Frankie
Newton, Pete Brown --

That's quite possible.
No, but I think Frankie Newton was
already there because -- see, at the time the Onyx
Club, while the street itself was called the Cradle
of Swing, and all the musicians used to hang out down
there --
